crossRefs.note: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!”
Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
“Now therefore arise, Yahweh God, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. Let your priests, Yahweh…
I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of…
For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit. Judah still strays from God, and is…
Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and…
Yahweh of Armies will defend them; and they will destroy and overcome with sling stones; and they will drink, and roar…
Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

translations.web: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
translations.bsb: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.
translations.kjv: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
translations.asv: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
